changelog:
🎉 What's New in FlixQuest v4.1.0

📱 **Redesigned Video Player**
• Portrait Inline Mode: Watch videos in portrait while browsing episodes, recommendations, or live channels underneath.
• Auto-Fullscreen: Turn your phone to landscape to go fullscreen instantly; turn back to restore inline mode.

⏭️ **IntroDB Skip Buttons & Next Episode**
• Skip intros, recaps, previews, and end credits with community-driven IntroDB markers!
• Floating "Next Episode" pill button appears right when end credits begin.

🎛 **Manual Source Picker ("Auto load sources")**
• Turn off "Auto load sources" in settings to choose your streaming provider before playback starts.
• Dedicated TV remote picker dialog with auto-retry if a provider fails.
• Switch providers on the fly inside the player without losing your place.

📺 **Android TV Upgrades**
• Dedicated Subtitle Settings: Adjust font size (5px–30px+), text colors (White, Yellow, Cyan, Green, Magenta), background contrast (Transparent to Solid Black), and font weight (Light/Regular/Bold).
• Subtitle Timing Sync: Shift subtitle offset (+/- ms) to fix desynced audio.
• Continue Watching Cleanup: Long-press items on TV to remove them from history.
• Performance improvement attempt

📊 **Viewing Insights**
• Complete viewing dashboard on Mobile and Android TV!
• Track total watch time (Movies, TV, Live TV), active streaks, binge sessions, and 24/7 peak viewing heatmaps.
• View your top genres, languages, release decades, and periodic recaps.

📲 **5 Android Home Screen Widgets**
• Add Continue Watching, Movie of the Day, TV Show of the Day, Bookmarks, and Wellness Stats to your home screen!
• Tap any widget to jump straight into that title.

🔑 **Google Sign-In & Multi-Device Sync**
• Google Sign-In now supported on Mobile and Android TV.
• Playback progress and Recently Watched history automatically sync across all your devices!

📡 **Live TV Improvements**
• New segmented UI for Channels, Schedules, Favorites, and Recents.
• Browse the channel guide and switch channels live beneath the player in portrait mode.
• Smarter stream recovery and reconnection handling.
• Better player stability

✨ **Extra Polish:**
• Custom HEX accent color picker for app theme and subtitle styling.
• Estimated file sizes shown before starting the download.
